evidence: brief/hld.md specifies about 1% hourly idle drain and about 1% per recorded clip
evidence/renderer.json resolves the raccoon physical battery to an explicit 25% anchor at 1:05 AM
interpretations.json rule 2-time permits the direct conflicting-anchor jump but not inconsistent intermediate values
deductions.explanation: The explicit 25% physical state at 1:05 AM invents a zero-drain intermediate rate, including no cost for the clip.

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json authors a new 1:00 AM battery report of 25% at raccoon
brief/hld.md specifies about 1% hourly idle drain
interpretations.json rule 2-time treats newly reported app battery and physical battery as distinct state claims
deductions.explanation: The new 1:00 AM report remains 25% after roughly 2.5 hours of stated idle drain.

evidence: evidence/renderer.json normal/open renders phone.power with reportedAt 7:00 AM and "Updated 1 h ago"
candidate/story.spec.json courier authors an 8:00 AM heartbeat through battery and status
brief/hld.md states every heartbeat reports charging yes/no
deductions.explanation: The visible power card falsely presents 7:00 AM as the latest report after the authored 8:00 AM heartbeat.

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json authors a 1:00 AM heartbeat through battery and status
evidence/renderer.json leaves phone.power reportedAt 10:30 PM and hidden on phoneScreen=home
brief/hld.md states each heartbeat includes charging yes/no
deductions.explanation: The stored power field contradicts the newly authored 1:00 AM heartbeat.

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json explicitly depicts a 4:00 AM heartbeat
evidence/renderer.json leaves phone.power reportedAt 10:30 PM and hidden
brief/hld.md states a heartbeat includes charging yes/no
deductions.explanation: The stored power report was not advanced with the explicit 4:00 AM heartbeat.

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json says the 6:30 AM check-in reported not charging
evidence/renderer.json leaves phone.power reportedAt 10:30 PM while battery and status use 6:30 AM
phoneScreen=home hides the field cards

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json says the app shows the solar charging icon
evidence/renderer.json keeps phoneScreen=home and phone.power renderedAsCard=false
interpretations.json rule 4-panels treats this as a missing promised panel event
deductions.explanation: The caption promises a visible charging icon, but the home screen hides the field containing it.

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json authors an 8:00 AM pre-outage heartbeat through battery and status
evidence/renderer.json leaves hidden phone.power reportedAt 7:00 AM
brief/hld.md states heartbeats include charging yes/no
deductions.explanation: The hidden power record contradicts the authored pre-outage 8:00 AM heartbeat.

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json says the app still shows the camera online from 8:00 AM
evidence/renderer.json keeps phoneScreen=home and phone.status renderedAsCard=false
interpretations.json rule 4-panels covers promised visible status hidden by the home screen

evidence: candidate/story.spec.json explicitly depicts an 8:15 AM reconnect heartbeat
evidence/renderer.json advances battery and status to 8:15 AM but leaves hidden phone.power at 7:00 AM
brief/hld.md states the reconnect heartbeat includes charging state
deductions.explanation: The hidden power record contradicts the explicit reconnect heartbeat.

evidence: brief/hld.md requires the resident to open the package clip on the normal path

interpretations.json rule 4-panels requires a clear open-clip depiction but not animation
deductions.explanation: The required clip-opening event is narrated but not depicted.
